subject: Subprocessor change notice — termination safeguard & data-flow capture
messages:
From: Elena Rivera <elena@quantumchain.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Cc: daniel.cho@quantumchain.ai
Date: 2027-04-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Notice: new subprocessor addition for QuantumChain order — list & proposed controls

Hi Kimberly / Priyom,

Per the change-notice clause in our Order Form, we wanted to let you know that QuantumChain intends to add a downstream processing partner (CloudPointe Labs) to support real-time log aggregation for the Redwood integration. Attached: a vendor roster and brief scope (QuantumChain_Subprocessor_List_20270415.xlsx).

Key points:
- CloudPointe will process only pseudonymized telemetry derived from inference logs (no raw prompt text).
- They will host in us-west-2 and will not copy data outside the region.
- Expected go-live: 2027-05-03 (pilot) / full: 2027-05-17.

Security asked us to include an escrow/termination assurance in case CloudPointe has a material control regression. We don’t want to slow things down — can we get confirmation on the required evidence pack (SOC2 + encryption-in-transit + key management notes) and whether Redwood needs a formal DPA amendment?

Attachments: QuantumChain_Subprocessor_List_20270415.xlsx (scope sheet)

Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Elena Rivera
Head of Integrations, QuantumChain AI
elena@quantumchain.ai

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rivera <elena@quantumchain.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-15T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: new subprocessor addition for QuantumChain order — list & proposed controls

Elena,

Thanks for the heads up and the roster. I reviewed the scope sheet — appreciate the regional detail and the filtering approach. A few items from legal/privacy we need to close before giving formal consent:

1) DPA amendment: yes — we’ll need an explicit update to the Data Processing Addendum to list CloudPointe as an authorized subprocessor and confirm the limited categories of data they will receive.

2) Termination safeguard: our security/privacy teams require a short-form termination carve-out in the Order Form that allows Redwood to suspend or direct the data flow if CloudPointe experiences a material control failure impacting customer data (with a remediation window and rights to escrow or return data). Suggested language attached as a redline in Redwood_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf.

3) Evidence pack: SOC 2 Type II and TLS config summary are baseline; additionally, we need confirmation on KMS usage (do they have customer-isolated keys or tenant-shared keys?) and whether they will persist derived telemetry beyond 30 days.

4) Operational SLA: for the pilot please confirm SLOs for log ingestion and incidence response playbook for incidents that could result in data exfiltration.

Cc’ing Connor (privacy) and Priyom (procurement) to align on timing and any commercial impact. I’ve attached a redline of the Order Form with the termination carve-out and a DPA amendment stub.

If you prefer, we can do a 30-min sync Thurs 04/16 to go through redline items and checklist.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rivera <elena@quantumchain.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-16T08:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: new subprocessor addition for QuantumChain order — list & proposed controls

Hey Elena / Kimberly,

Thanks for the detail — quick commercial note from procurement: if the termination carve-out requires significant operational escrow or increased monitoring, we will likely need to document the change as an Order Form amendment with an associated uplift to the processing fees (to cover secure transfer and short-term retention costs).

Marissa — can you advise on the expected uplift scope if we require an escrow / extended evidence collection?

Elena — can you confirm (by EOD) whether CloudPointe uses a tenant-per-customer KMS or a shared key model, and whether they will allow on-demand export of the derived telemetry within a 14-day request window? That will help us size any fee impact.

Thanks,
Priyom
Director, Procurement — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, Elena Rivera <elena@quantumchain.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-17T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: new subprocessor addition for QuantumChain order — list & proposed controls

Hi all,

From a commercial perspective — short answer: likely a small one‑time amendment fee plus a recurring processing uplift for the increased data residency/escrow requirements. Rough estimate: 3–6% uplift on monthly processing for pilot tier, plus a $2,500 secure-transfer setup if CloudPointe requires a managed export/escrow.

Operational ask: we’ll need a 2‑week mutual action plan (MAP) that includes DPA amendment sign-off and a demo of CloudPointe’s control evidence (SOC report + TLS/KMS screenshots).

If Legal is OK with Kimberly’s redline, I can prepare an order amendment and send the DocuSign packet.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference

From: Elena Rivera <elena@quantumchain.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Cc: daniel.cho@quantumchain.ai, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: new subprocessor addition for QuantumChain order — list & proposed controls

Kimberly / Priyom / Marissa,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We’ve run this past CloudPointe — they support customer-isolated keys (KMS tenant model) and can commit to a 30-day retention cap for derived telemetry during the pilot (can be shortened on request). They can provide SOC2 summary + TLS cipher suite list by tomorrow.

QuantumChain accepts the redline in principle pending the MAP and DPA amendment. We’re fine with the proposed commercial uplift — please send the amendment and DocuSign link and we’ll route internally for signature.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/QC-OrderForm-2027
Drive evidence: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cQCAPTURE

Elena
